# EXPANSION CW133-01 — The Room Will Be Different Again

## 1. Expansion thesis

This plan expands attention around the room will be different again while leaving the journal row intact. Its center is three sounds missing from a dormitory that has become familiar. The bank offers different distances and registers for rereading the same recorded material; it does not add a new day, memory, event, relationship, quest, or system.

## 2. Story question

How does a room change when its familiar breathing disappears, and no one has to explain every silence?

## 3. Verified source record

The complete JSON entry below is copied from the current local source. Preserve its id, author_id, author_name, day, hour, knowledge_key, timestamp, and exact text. Candidate prose is editorial material, not part of the loaded row.

```json
{
  "id": "journal_raw_b3_21_widow_the_sound_of_three",
  "text": "The dormitory is missing three sounds tonight. The Courier is not here — he is on the warehouse walk. The Hunter is not here — he is with the Courier. The Exhausted Father is here but his daughter's cough is not, because the Surgeon says the dust has cleared and the cough is better, and the absence of a cough is a different kind of absence. I have learned the breathing of seven people. Tonight it is five and the two missing are the ones I did not realise I had learned until they were gone. The Bouncer still calls out his sister's name. I know it is his sister now. The Therapist did not tell me. The Bouncer told me, on Day 180, in the mess hall, without anyone asking. He said, 'The name is my sister. I say it in my sleep. I do not remember saying it.' I said, 'I know. I listen.' He looked at me and I looked at him and we did not say anything else. That is the kind of knowing the bunker is full of now. The knowing that does not need the words. The dormitory is missing three sounds and the three sounds are the Courier's breathing and the Hunter's breathing and the Exhausted Father's daughter's cough, and I did not know I had learned them until the room was different. I will know when they are back. The room will be different again. The different is how I know.",
  "timestamp": "Day 183, 23h",
  "author_name": "The Widow",
  "author_id": "the_widow",
  "knowledge_key": "widow_three_sounds_absent",
  "day": 183,
  "hour": 23.0
}
```

## 4. Fixed canon and open space

The Widow counts the Courier and Hunter as absent and notices the Exhausted Father’s daughter is no longer coughing after the Surgeon says the dust has cleared. She has learned seven people’s breathing and hears five that night. The Bouncer has told her the name he calls in sleep is his sister’s. Do not interpret the sister’s fate or add a reason for the absent expedition members. Candidate language may add an image, rhythm, or private impression as an editorial draft, but no proposed addition becomes a further remembered event or confirmed fact until the existing content owner selects and reviews it against the source.

## 5. Human center

The source voice is The Widow. The Widow notices the dormitory through sound and the knowledge that arrives without a formal conversation. Hold the improved cough, the missing breaths, and the Bouncer’s confidence in her listening as separate facts. The prose may notice what the author can count, hear, repair, fear, or leave uncertain, while keeping the account’s limits visible.
